events.title: Accounting for your Future

Whether you’re just starting your journey or looking to take the next step in your academic and professional career, this event is for you. Don’t miss this opportunity to explore your future! Register now to secure your spot and join us for a day of learning, networking, and great food. Enjoy free pizza lunch while you engage in meaningful discussions, expand your knowledge, and connect with peers and professionals in the field. What to expect: Explore dynamic and rewarding career opportunities in accounting. Industry professionals will share their experiences, provide insight into various career paths, and discuss the demand for skilled accountants in today’s job market. Discover how you can seamlessly transition from your community college to university business school. Representatives will be on hand to discuss transfer requirements, scholarship opportunities, and how to make the most of your credits. Connect with recruiters from leading accounting firms. This is your chance to ask questions, learn about the recruiting process, and start building your professional relationships that will be key to your future.

Backed by his band, Palmetto Motel, Betts delivers a dynamic live show filled with searing guitar solos, heartfelt storytelling, and a mix of classic influences with fresh energy. events.title: Pageturners Book Discussion: The Tyranny of Merit: What’s Become of the Common Good?
events.summary: Join PageTurners for a book discussion on 'The Tyranny of Merit: What’s Become of the Common Good?' by Michael J. Sandel. The world-renowned philosopher and author of the bestselling Justice explores the central question of our time: What has become of the common good? These are dangerous times for democracy. We live in an age of winners and losers, where the odds are stacked in favor of the already fortunate. Stalled social mobility and entrenched inequality give the lie to the American credo that 'you can make it if you try'. The consequence is a brew of anger and frustration that has fueled populist protest and extreme polarization, and led to deep distrust of both government and our fellow citizens–leaving us morally unprepared to face the profound challenges of our time. World-renowned philosopher Michael J. Sandel argues that to overcome the crises that are upending our world, we must rethink the attitudes toward success and failure that have accompanied globalization and rising inequality. Sandel shows the hubris a meritocracy generates among the winners and the harsh judgement it imposes on those left behind, and traces the dire consequences across a wide swath of American life. He offers an alternative way of thinking about success–more attentive to the role of luck in human affairs, more conducive to an ethic of humility and solidarity, and more affirming of the dignity of work. _The Tyranny of Merit_ points us toward a hopeful vision of a new politics of the common good.
events.imageAlt: Pageturners Book Discussion: The Tyranny of Merit: What’s Become of the Common Good?
